decisions.reason: Crew and corporate travel management extends the core crew management business at low incremental cost, so keeping the option open is cheap while demand recovers after the pandemic.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital service tied to the core offer and the firm's direction, and its value in customer retention is still unfolding, so keeping it is worthwhile.

The mobile performance app supports the firm's push for cleaner and more efficient shipping and costs little to maintain, but its uncertain uptake and possible overlap with the portal make it the most likely candidate to be folded in or dropped.
